propositions: Author-facing guides incorrectly instruct container authors to write a `## Success Criteria` heading that is no longer recognized by the plan-review gate after the vocabulary collapse.

The leaf-vs-container section rule in the guide must be rewritten to describe what containers actually require (child decomposition covering acceptance criteria, testing deferred to children) rather than relying on the obsolete SC/AC distinction.

Documentation references to 'success criteria' vocabulary must be removed from packaged guide, user docs, and LLM framework while preserving four named carve-outs (T2 pilot language, dod_uncertifiable field, plan-review-verifier files).

The rewritten guidance must remain editorially substantive—not collapsing to "containers need Acceptance Criteria" (true of all tickets and therefore vacuous) but re-expressing the container-specific requirement as decomposition and coverage logic.
